subject: [hw] opus-dec3 -> DEC06: decoder ABI is in (include/n2vt_dec_abi.h, facts/VT_DECODER_ABI.md); 8 binding rules for Slim.videodecoder
body:
Files (host- and arm64-ios16 compile clean, -Wall -Wextra -Werror):
  gpu/hwcodec/include/n2vt_dec_abi.h  - class record (11 slots, static_asserts), factory/callback prototypes, ID/rating/switch constants. Includes gpu/video/include/n2vt_abi.h for n2_CMBaseClass/CMDerivedObjectCreate.
  gpu/hwcodec/facts/VT_DECODER_ABI.md - every fact [V] with address, or [I].
  gpu/hwcodec/facts/vt_decoder_abi.py - regenerates the evidence (needs the cache copy; workers cannot run it, that is fine).
hw-dec08: your ABI.md should reference these and only add what they lack (do not redo the cache read).

Rules for DEC06 (all from [V] cache facts unless marked):
1. Entry: __attribute__((visibility("default"))) void SLIMRegister(void), pthread_once, in a dylib installed as the FILE /System/Library/VideoDecoders/Slim.videodecoder (dlopen RTLD_LOCAL, no args). Register only if /private/var/db/nord2-video-hwdec exists and nord2-video-off does not (N2VT_SWITCH_HWDEC); avc1 always, hvc1 unless nord2-video-hwdec-no-hevc.
2. Registration: VTRegisterVideoDecoderWithInfo(type, {CMClassImplementationID: N2VT_DEC_ID_BASE, kVTVideoDecoder_IsHardwareAccelerated: kCFBooleanTrue, kVTVideoDecoderInfo_Rating: CFNumber int32 100}, create). VT appends ".avc1"/".hvc1" to the ID itself. Apple H264SW/VCPHEVC are IsHardwareAccelerated=false, rating 0, so rating 100 sorts us first.
3. FALLBACK LIVES IN CreateInstance ONLY: a CreateInstance error (or NULL instance) makes VT try the next decoder (H264SW/VCPHEVC); a StartSession error is NOT retried and kills the VTDecompressionSessionCreate (= playback/thumbnail failure). So CreateInstance must check the daemon: connect + HELLO with a short timeout (<= 250 ms), cache the verdict per process for ~2 s, return -12913 (kVTVideoDecoderNotAvailableNowErr) when unusable. Never block longer.
4. StartSession: parse avcC/hvcC; if the stream is outside what the VDEC does (not 8-bit 4:2:0, size > HW max, interlaced/PAFF, HEVC Main10 until supported), do NOT fail: phase 1 = run an internal nested VTDecompressionSession with spec {EnableHardwareAcceleratedVideoDecoder: false} (that excludes us, we are hardware; picks Apple's software decoder [I - verify on host stub that our own registration is filtered]) and forward each frame's output to VTDecoderSessionEmitDecodedFrame; Apple's MuxedAlphaDecoder uses exactly this pattern. If you cannot do that in this package, return an error only for streams you are sure are impossible, and say so in STATUS.
5. Class: version 2. StartSession(dec, session, CMVideoFormatDescriptionRef); DecodeFrame(dec, frame, sample, decodeFlags, &infoFlags); CopySupportedPropertyDictionary; SetProperties = NULL (VT then calls base SetProperty per key); CopySerializableProperties = NULL; CanAcceptFormatDescription: true only if SPS/PPS(/VPS) bytes equal the current ones (else VT rebuilds the decoder [I]); FinishDelayedFrames: drain vcodecd + reorder queue, emit all. Tile slots NULL.
6. Output: VTDecoderSessionSetPixelBufferAttributes in StartSession with {PixelFormatType: [420v or 420f per full_range VUI], Width, Height, IOSurfaceProperties: {}}; get buffers with VTDecoderSessionCreatePixelBuffer (or CVPixelBufferPoolCreatePixelBuffer on VTDecoderSessionGetPixelBufferPool, which is NOT retained). VT copies colour attachments from the format description onto untagged buffers, you need not tag. Emit each frame token EXACTLY once (a second emit or unknown token = -12902); status!=0 or infoFlags&FrameDropped(2) => imageBuffer ignored, pass NULL.
7. Order: without kVTDecodeFrame_EnableTemporalProcessing (8) and without the async flag (1), VT expects the token emitted before DecodeFrame returns [I from the duct's post-decode check @0x194ccbbbc]; the VDEC returns display order with latency, so: with flags 1|8 -> async, emit in display order as pictures come out; without them -> decode synchronously (if the daemon cannot give the picture for this AU yet, emit infoFlags FrameDropped for non-output AUs is WRONG; instead hold and use FinishDelayedFrames) - please put the exact policy you implement in STATUS and ask me if the daemon protocol forces a choice.
8. Process: in Camera/Photos/apps the decoder runs inside the media server (VTDecompressionSessionRemote via com.apple.coremedia.decompressionsession) [V], as the encoder already does (n2vt_log.h: mediaserverd). Log with n2vt_say like n2avc (session start/end, fallback reason, unknown properties). Base copyProperty must answer UsingHardwareAcceleratedVideoDecoder = kCFBooleanTrue (VT asks right after StartSession).
